Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.hook

Interface DrawableHooks

All Known Subinterfaces:
CubismPlugin
public interface DrawableHooks
Override-based lifecycle hooks for admitted ArtMesh authoring operations.

before methods synchronously compose native arguments. on observes only confirmed changes and after observes normal completion. Runtime dispatch owns host-thread scheduling and isolates callback failures.
